OmopTrainer

OmopTrainer checks whether an R session has the software, packages, and data needed for an OMOP training. It reports the checks that pass or need attention and gives commands or instructions to address common setup problems. It does not install software or packages automatically.

Installation

Install the development version from GitHub:

install.packages("pak")
pak::pak("oxford-pharmacoepi/OmopTrainer")

Check your setup

Run the validator from an R session:

OmopTrainer::validateSetup()

The default base training specification checks that:

  • R 4.1 or later is installed.
  • Rtools is available on Windows.
  • All required R packages are installed. Packages with an explicit (>= version) requirement must meet that minimum; packages without one are not checked for updates.
  • The required mock datasets are downloaded and DuckDB is installed.
  • Quarto is installed.
  • GitHub Desktop is installed.

On macOS, GitHub Desktop is detected in /Applications, ~/Applications, or ~/Downloads. If you cannot move it to Applications, extract the download so that GitHub Desktop.app is directly inside your Downloads folder. A ZIP file alone is not enough.

If packages are missing, the validator prints an install.packages() command to copy into the R console. If an installed package is below its stated minimum, install it from a repository that provides that version; the configured repository may not have a suitable release. The validator does not install anything automatically. Rtools, Quarto, and GitHub Desktop must be installed separately when required.

Configure the OMOP data folder

Set OMOP_DATA_FOLDER to a local folder where omock can store its mock datasets. The simplest way is to open your user .Renviron file:

usethis::edit_r_environ()

Add a line with the path to your folder, for example:

OMOP_DATA_FOLDER="/Users/your-name/OMOP"

On Windows, use a path such as C:/Users/your-name/OMOP. Save the file and restart R so the environment variable takes effect. Run OmopTrainer::validateSetup() and follow its package installation instructions before downloading data. The omock package must be installed to download the mock datasets.

Download the datasets required by the default training specification:

omock::downloadMockDataset("delphi-100k")
omock::downloadMockDataset("synpuf-1k")

Run OmopTrainer::validateSetup() again to confirm the datasets are available.

Training specifications

The package currently includes a base specification. Package developers can edit the YAML specification in data-raw/specs/ and regenerate the internal specification data with source("data-raw/specs.R").
